Read `REFINEMENT_TASK.md` completely and execute it as an autonomous controlled-refinement goal.

Use `baseline/template/` as the immutable selected M Run-02 baseline. Copy it to `output/template/`, then fix every confirmed defect in `audit/DEFECT_DOSSIER.md` while preserving every binding policy, trigger role, scope requirement, useful V2 detail, and Candidate M identity.

Approve a change only when the resulting template is demonstrably better than the baseline under the promotion gate in `REFINEMENT_TASK.md`. Revert or omit any change that is merely cosmetic, subjective, tied, or regressive. Do not merge Run-01 ideas automatically; adopt an optional idea only when its net benefit is proven.

Perform the required primary substantive audit, repair concrete defects, then run the confirmation audit. Stop when all confirmed defects are eliminated, all acceptance/regression gates pass, and `output/REFINEMENT_REPORT.md` can truthfully report `STRICTLY_BETTER`. If strict improvement cannot be achieved without regression, report `NOT_PROMOTED` rather than weakening a requirement.

Do not ask for follow-up guidance for defects resolvable from the supplied workspace, and do not inspect parent/sibling workspaces, 5.2, network resources, or external repositories.
